concepts.title: ACTIVATION PROCEDURE
concepts.description: Outlines the procedure for activating Cascaded RET Support, including preconditions, rollout strategy, traffic impact, and step-by-step CLI commands.

concepts.title: Deactivation Procedure
concepts.description: Instructions and CLI commands for deactivating the Cascaded RET Support feature and verifying device management state.

concepts.title: Feature Dependencies
concepts.description: Defines the feature, hardware, and network dependencies, as well as operational limits, for Cascaded RET Support.

concepts.title: Feature Operation
concepts.description: Describes the operational workflow, AISG bus scanning, device discovery, calibration, electrical tilt configuration, and continuous supervision for Cascaded RET.

concepts.title: Feature Overview
concepts.description: Overview of Cascaded RET Support extending Remote Electrical Tilt control to daisy-chained AISG devices on a single bus.

concepts.title: NETWORK IMPACT
concepts.description: Details the impact of Cascaded RET Support on coverage/capacity, end users, O&M load, and site operations.

concepts.title: PARAMETERS
concepts.description: Configuration parameters governing bus scanning behavior and per-device tilt control for Cascaded RET Support.

concepts.title: Performance Management
concepts.description: Provides performance management guidelines, KPIs, and counters for evaluating device health, tilt operation, and bus stability in Cascaded RET Support.
